rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; HCP discovery cohort across 4 sites and ASRB validation cohort across 5 sites.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "For HCP (discovery), each measure was harmonized across 4 sites: HCP-young adult sample (site 1) and 3 sites comprising the HCP-Psychosis dataset. For ASRB (validation),  each  measure  was  harmonized  across  5  sites  comprising  the  ASRB  dataset."

rci2_using_epd.detail: HCP-Young Adult Sample and HCP-Psychosis used in normative model training; HCP is an EPD.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "This study comprised a total of 1849 participants drawn from three independent datasets: (1) the Human Connectome Project-Young Adult Sample [15]; (2) the Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis (HCPpsychosis) [16]; and (3) the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB) [17]."
